* **rename-rpc ShippingService.GetQuote** → detected=True, bindings 39→36 (lost 3); dangling consumers: src/checkoutservice/main.go:checkoutService.quoteShipping, src/frontend/rpc.go:frontendServer.getShippingQuote; dangling producers: src/shippingservice/main.go:server.GetQuote
* **remove-rpc CartService.GetCart** → detected=True, bindings 39→37 (lost 2); dangling consumers: src/checkoutservice/main.go:checkoutService.getUserCart, src/frontend/rpc.go:frontendServer.getCart; dangling producers: none parsed (C#)
